package.description: The Premier All-In-One XML Editing Suite

en-US.description: The Premier All-In-One XML Editing Suite
en-US.longDescription: Oxygen XML Editor is the premier tool for XML authoring and development. Tailored for all users (from beginners to experts), it is versatile, cross-platform, and available as both a standalone application and Eclipse plugin. Boasting robust support for XML technologies, it offers tools for easy content creation, editing, and publishing. It can be further enhanced by using the Oxygen AI Positron Assistant plugin to add AI capabilities for creating and rewriting content while keeping the user in full control.
en-US.name: Oxygen XML Editor

zh-CN.description: 一站式 XML 编辑解决方案
zh-CN.longDescription: Oxygen XML Editor 是 XML 创作与开发的顶尖工具。它适用于所有用户（从新手到专家），具备多功能性、跨平台特性，并可作为独立应用程序或 Eclipse 插件使用。凭借对 XML 技术的强大支持，该工具提供便捷的内容创建、编辑和发布功能。通过安装 Oxygen AI Positron Assistant 插件，用户可进一步获得 AI 辅助创作与内容重写能力，同时始终保持对内容的完全掌控。
